company.shortDescription: Vitau is a subscription model pharmacy for patients with chronic diseases.
company.description:
Vitau is a subscription model pharmacy for patients with chronic diseases. Every month, they deliver all the medicines that a patient with chronic diseases needs, and support them with all the procedures of their insurance company. It makes users subscribe to select products or medicines and order them online using a payment method that is accessible via the internet

Vitau's mission is to improve people's health and lives through simple technology and excellent customer service. It was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Mexico.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,300,000 to $14,885,993, a 4.51x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
